info.name: ALTR Classification Engine ALTR Managed Collections API

items.docs: Retrieves the list of ALTR Managed (regex) classifiers available for import. Backward-compatible alias for /collections/altr-managed/regex/classifiers.

Imports the ALTR Managed (regex / ALTR-native) classifiers into your organization and creates/updates the "ALTR Managed" collection. Idempotent - safe to call repeatedly to get the latest classifiers. Backward-compatible alias for /collections/altr-managed/regex/import.
Creates/updates every ALTR managed collection (regex, gdlp, aws-comprehend, snowflake-native, stoplight) and syncs their classifiers to the latest shipped versions. Idempotent.

info.name: Get ALTR managed collection version timestamps (regex)

items.docs: Returns version information for the ALTR Managed (regex) classifiers. Compare altr_managed_classifiers_timestamp (latest available) with org_altr_managed_classifiers_timestamp (installed) to determine if an update is available. Backward-compatible alias for /collections/altr-managed/regex/timestamp.

info.name: Get version timestamps for all ALTR managed collections

items.docs: Returns, per collection slug, the latest-available and installed timestamps so a client can detect which managed collections are stale in one call.

info.name: List available ALTR managed classifiers for a collection

params.name: slug
params.description: Managed collection slug (regex, gdlp, aws-comprehend, snowflake-native, stoplight)

items.docs: Retrieves the list of ALTR managed classifiers available for import for the given collection slug.

info.name: Import a specific ALTR managed collection

params.name: slug
params.description: Managed collection slug (regex, gdlp, aws-comprehend, snowflake-native, stoplight)

items.docs: Imports the ALTR managed classifiers for the given collection slug (regex, gdlp, aws-comprehend, snowflake-native, stoplight) and creates/updates the corresponding collection. Idempotent.

info.name: Get a specific ALTR managed collection's version timestamps

params.name: slug
params.description: Managed collection slug (regex, gdlp, aws-comprehend, snowflake-native, stoplight)

items.docs: Returns latest-available vs installed timestamps for the given managed collection slug.
